knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.7
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. For nested models A ⊂ B: what do you compare with analysis of deviance, and what does a large improvement suggest?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Compare deviance of A vs B (Δ deviance / related test). Large improvement supports the richer model if parameters are significant and warranted.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.7
knowledge_checks.prompt: Refuse: 'always fit the biggest GLM.' Give an analysis-of-deviance warrant for a smaller model.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse kitchen-sink. If Δ deviance and parameter significance do not support extra terms, prefer the smaller suitable model.
